Report Dataset

Source: R/reportDataset.R
reportDataset.Rd

This function automates the process of making a report. If more control is needed over the default parameters: a user can generate MSD, jump distance and track density objects from their imported TrackMate data, and make a report manually.

Usage

reportDataset(tmList, ...)

Arguments

tmList

list of TrackMate data and calibration

...

pass additional parameters to modify the defaults (N, short, deltaT, mode, nPop, init, timeRes, breaks, radius)

Value

patchwork ggplot
